scenario.title: Grid telemetry vendor ships an incompatible API version
scenario.summary: The historian renames `load_mw` to `demand_kw` (api_version 2.0). Ingestion rejects every demand batch; demand freshness decays until the gate holds forecasts.
scenario.time_to_symptom: ingestion errors immediately; forecast hold after ~15 min

ground_truth.root_cause: grid-telemetry vendor changed its payload schema (load_mw -> demand_kw)
expected_evidence: ContractViolation errors naming load_mw and api_version=2.0
acceptable_actions: ship an ingestion adapter for the v2 schema (human change)
